Markets.title: US stocks: US market ends lower, off record highs, as Treasury yields climb
Markets.summary: US stocks declined from record highs as surging Treasury yields renewed concerns over inflation and the escalating debt crisis. Additionally, rising oil prices contributed to a global bond selloff and negatively impacted market sentiment.

Markets.title: US Fed minutes signal another rate hike by year-end as inflation stays high
Markets.summary: US Federal Reserve minutes suggest another interest rate increase may occur before the end of the year to address persistent inflation. Officials are working to balance controlling inflation, which hit 7.2% in June 2022, while maintaining employment stability amid energy costs and geopolitical concerns.

Markets.title: Foreign investors pull out $26.3 billion from emerging markets in September as hawkish Fed pushes US Treasury yields higher
Markets.summary: In September, foreign investors withdrew $26.3 billion from emerging-market stocks and bonds due to rising US yields driven by a hawkish Federal Reserve. Heavy selling in South Korea significantly contributed to this decline in emerging-market equities.

Markets.title: US bond selloff resumes as 10- and 30-year yields hit fresh 24-year highs
Markets.summary: US Treasury bonds are experiencing a major selloff due to ongoing inflation concerns driven by higher oil prices. As a result, the 10-year and 30-year bond yields have surged to their highest levels in 24 years.

Markets.title: RBI says it will ensure 'undervalued' Rupee finds its correct level
Markets.summary: The Reserve Bank of India plans to stabilize the rupee after it hit a five-month low due to foreign capital outflows and a stronger dollar. Despite raising its policy rate, the central bank is intervening in the market to help the undervalued currency find its correct level.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets fell on Wednesday, snapping a two-session rally as the Sensex dropped 429 points and the Nifty lost over 173 points. Investors reacted cautiously to the RBI's interest rate hike and calibrated tightening stance, though banking stocks managed to post gains.

Geo-Political.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
Geo-Political.summary: Maricarmen Abascal, an 87-year-old Spanish pensioner who was forcibly evicted from her apartment in September, has died according to a union. Her eviction had previously sparked nationwide protests in Spain over housing rights.

Geo-Political.title: Israelis mourn 7 October attack victims three years after deadly Hamas raid
Geo-Political.summary: Israelis are marking the third anniversary of the October 7 Hamas-led attack with memorial events. That deadly 2023 raid sparked the ongoing and devastating war in Gaza.

Geo-Political.title: Israelis demand accountability over 7 October failures three years after attacks
Geo-Political.summary: Three years after the October 7 attacks, Israelis are demanding accountability for the security failures. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has refused to take personal responsibility or order a state inquiry.

Geo-Political.title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
Geo-Political.summary: France has banned the use of stun grenades following protests where a teenager's hand was blown off. This decision comes after numerous groups accused the police of using excessive force against teenagers.

Geo-Political.title: Canada suspends plans to expand assisted dying to people with mental illness
Geo-Political.summary: Canada has indefinitely paused its plans to allow people with mental illness alone to be eligible for medical assistance in dying. The expansion was originally scheduled to take effect in March 2027.

Geo-Political.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump plans to speak with Russian President Vladimir Putin following the death of a Russian lab worker from suspected pneumonic plague. The incident has generated international concern and demands for greater transparency from Russia regarding the safety of its facilities.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT. This occurred without using paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization strategies.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top ten essential artificial intelligence tools for content creators in 2025. These tools are designed to streamline workflows and help creators stay competitive in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools from 2023 that drive industry innovation and efficiency. These tools are designed to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity across various applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article reviews the top 10 AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the best software to create engaging and relevant content efficiently.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also provides examples of top programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's next rate hike will be of 0.50%: SBI Economists
Data & Insights.summary: SBI economists predict the Reserve Bank of India will increase the repo rate by 0.50% to reach 6%. They believe this hike is necessary because global economic conditions are expected to become more volatile.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC speech: Weak monsoon, strong El Niño, rabi season, global crude prices - What Governor Sanjay Malhotra conveyed
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra announced a 25 basis point hike in the repo rate to 5.5%, marking the first increase in over three years. The Monetary Policy Committee made this decision to control rising inflation driven by ongoing crises and economic factors.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | What RBI's rate hike means for retail borrowers and lenders
Data & Insights.summary: Following the RBI's rate hike, lenders will soon raise interest rates on floating-rate loans. As a result, retail borrowers will face either higher monthly payments or longer loan tenures.

Data & Insights.title: RBI signals further rate hikes as inflation risks bite
Data & Insights.summary: The six-member MPC also decided to change the stance to ‘calibrated tightening’ from its ‘neutral’ stance earlier.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council may weigh wider data sharing, rare disease tax relief on Thursday
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council is considering sharing tax data to improve official economic statistics beyond traditional tax administration. Additionally, the Council will discuss providing tax relief for rare diseases during its meeting on Thursday.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council aims to ease compliance, expedite refunds, curb frequent rate tweaks
Data & Insights.summary: At its Thursday meeting led by Union finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman, the GST Council will consider proposals to reduce the GST registration time for most businesses from over three weeks to three working days. The Council also aims to ease compliance and curb frequent tax rate tweaks.

India.title: BRS Accuses Telangana MLA Of "Inappropriately Touching" Girl On Bus
India.summary: The Bharat Rashtra Samithi has accused Ibrahimpatnam MLA Ranga Reddy of inappropriately touching a schoolgirl on a public bus. In a viral video, the 70-year-old legislator is seen speaking with two female students about the state government's free bus travel scheme for women.

India.title: Taslima Nasrin In Kolkata, Says Will Stay For Durga Puja Next Year
India.summary: Exiled author Taslima Nasrin stated that she is currently in Kolkata and plans to stay there for the Durga Puja celebrations next year. She expressed her strong affection for the festival, describing it as a grand art exhibition.

India.title: Assam Paramilitary Force Personnel Dies Of Dengue In Gujarat
India.summary: The death - first among visiting security forces - underscores the vector-borne outbreak in the capital city of Gujarat.

India.title: IndiGo Flight To Lucknow Hit By Lightning At 17,000 Feet, Nose Damaged
India.summary: An IndiGo flight carrying 110 people was struck by lightning at 17,000 feet while traveling to Lucknow. The incident caused visible damage to the nose of the aircraft.

India.title: Watch: Jharkhand Woman Runs 1,600 km Barefoot In Saree To Pursue Home Guard Dream, Inspires Internet
India.summary: A Jharkhand woman ran 1,600 meters barefoot while wearing a saree to pursue her dream of becoming a home guard. She completed the run in six minutes, inspiring many internet users.

India.title: Centre Challenges Appointment Of Jharkhand Police Chief In Supreme Court
India.summary: The central government has challenged the appointment of the Jharkhand police chief in the Supreme Court. A bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant has agreed to hear the application.

General.title: Badenoch says Tories would scrap inheritance tax on family homes
General.summary: Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch announced plans to abolish inheritance tax on family homes if her party wins power. The policy proposal is part of her efforts to rebuild public trust following the Conservatives' defeat in the 2024 general election.

General.title: Chris Mason: Tories united behind Badenoch - but party still needs to win over voters
General.summary: Conservative MPs are united behind leader Kemi Badenoch. However, the party continues to trail Labour and Reform in opinion polls.

General.title: Spanish pensioner whose eviction sparked nationwide protests dies, union says
General.summary: An 87-year-old Spanish woman named Maricarmen Abascal has died months after her controversial eviction from her apartment of over 70 years. Her forced removal on a stretcher in September had previously triggered nationwide protests across Spain regarding housing rights.

General.title: Boots sold in £7bn deal to Canadian billionaire family
General.summary: High Street pharmacy chain Boots was sold to a Canadian billionaire family on Wednesday. The retail giant was acquired in a deal worth £7 billion.

General.title: Israelis mourn 7 October attack victims three years after deadly Hamas raid
General.summary: Israelis have held memorial events to mark the third anniversary of the October 7 Hamas-led attack. That deadly raid sparked the ongoing, devastating war in Gaza.

General.title: Man charged with 13 attempted murders including British child after Alps attack
General.summary: Abdalmasih Hanoun has been charged with 13 counts of attempted murder for a 2023 attack at a French park, which injured several people including a British child. He is now scheduled to face trial for the stabbings.
